title: Help Center | Oxira
description: Answers about building your site with Oxira Studio, your account, add-ons, billing, domains and the partner program.
lead: Quick answers about your website, your account and Oxira's services. Can't find what you need? We're one email away.
noResults: No articles match your search. Try other words or contact us.

articles.q: How do I build my site with Oxira Studio?
a: Open Oxira Studio at /website-builder/.
Describe your business, or pick one of 81 designs across 27 business categories.
Edit the text, colors and images, then preview your site.
When you're happy with it, choose a package and pay.

articles.q: What packages are available?
a: There are three one-time packages: 1,499 SAR, 2,499 SAR (domain included) and 4,999 SAR.
Prices are shown before 15% VAT.

articles.q: What happens after I pay?
a: Your site is published at yourname.oxira.sa.
You receive a welcome email with your site link and access to your account.

articles.q: Can my site be in Arabic or other languages?
a: Yes. Sites support Arabic as well as other languages.

articles.q: How do I sign in to my account?
a: Go to /account/ and enter your email.
We'll email you a sign-in link — there's no password to remember.
The link stays valid for 30 days.

articles.q: What can I do in my account?
a: See your site and your subscriptions, and add or cancel add-ons.
Edit settings such as your Google review link and booking hours, and edit your menu.
View bookings, reviews and tickets, and check in tickets using your camera.

articles.q: What happens when I cancel an add-on?
a: The add-on keeps working until the end of the month you've already paid for.
You can resume it any time before then.

articles.q: Online booking (99 SAR/month)
a: Customers choose a service, date and time right on your site.
You get an email for every booking.
Set your working hours and time slots from your account.
Customers receive email reminders before their appointment.

articles.q: Digital menu (49 SAR/month)
a: Organize your menu into categories, items and prices, and edit it anytime.
Download a QR code or print a table card for your customers.

articles.q: Customer reviews (79 SAR/month)
a: You get a review page and a QR card to share with customers.
Every customer sees the Google review button.
Low ratings and comments are also emailed to you.
Add your Google review link in your account settings.

articles.q: AI chat assistant (199 SAR/month)
a: An AI assistant answers visitors using your site's information, in your site's language.
When a visitor leaves their contact details, you get an email.
Please note that AI can make mistakes.

articles.q: Social media content (499 SAR/month)
a: On the 1st of every month you get 12 ready-to-post social media posts with captions.
They're delivered by email and in your account, for you to review and post.

articles.q: Event tickets (free to enable, 5% per paid ticket)
a: Run free or paid events from your site.
Customers pay by card, mada or Apple Pay through Moyasar.
Each attendee receives a QR ticket by email.
Check in attendees from your account.

articles.q: Google SEO (299 or 799 SAR/month)
a: Basic (299 SAR): Google Search Console connection, weekly tracking of up to 10 keywords, the number of calls, WhatsApp messages, emails and contact-form messages from your site, monthly title and description suggestions, two Google Maps posts a month, a technical check and a monthly report you can print or save as PDF.
Growth (799 SAR): everything in Basic plus 4 articles and 2 local pages every month in Arabic and English, tracking of up to 30 keywords, four Google Maps posts and automatic publishing to WordPress.

In the “Google visibility” tab of your account, fill in “Your business details”: services, cities, what makes you different, target keywords and competitors. Suggestions and rank tracking are built on them.
Every suggestion or draft appears in your account to publish, edit or reject; nothing goes live without your approval.
Nobody can guarantee first place on Google; results usually take 3 to 6 months.

articles.q: Do prices include VAT?
a: No. All prices are in Saudi riyals (SAR) and shown before 15% VAT.

articles.q: How can I pay?
a: You can pay by card, mada or Apple Pay.
Payments are processed by Moyasar. Oxira never stores your card details.
A receipt is emailed to you after each payment.

articles.q: What are the renewal costs?
a: From the second year: hosting is 399 SAR/year and the domain is 99 SAR/year.
We email your renewal invoice 14 days before yearly renewals and 5 days before monthly ones, followed by reminders.

articles.q: What if an invoice isn't paid?
a: If an invoice is still unpaid 7 days after its due date, the site or add-on is paused.
Once you pay, it comes back.

articles.q: Does my site get a free address?
a: Yes. Every site gets a free address: yourname.oxira.sa.

articles.q: When is my domain registered?
a: If your package includes a domain, we register it for you once your payment is confirmed.

articles.q: Why does a .sa domain take longer?
a: .sa domains are registered manually, so they can take longer than other domains.

articles.q: Can I use a domain I already own?
a: Yes. Contact us and we'll help you connect it to your site.

articles.q: How do I connect my own domain to Google Search Console for the Google SEO add-on?
a: Sites on <name>.oxira.sa need nothing: Oxira already sees their Google data.
If your domain's DNS is managed by Oxira (you bought the domain through us or moved it to us), we verify it in Google Search Console automatically within a day of subscribing.

If you already use Google Search Console for your domain: open Search Console → Settings → Users and permissions → Add user, enter the email we sent you, choose "Restricted" (read-only), then click Add.

If your domain is managed elsewhere and you don't use Search Console: add the TXT record we email you in your domain's DNS settings (name: @ or your domain, type: TXT, value: as sent), or reply to our email and we'll guide you. Google usually confirms within a few hours.

articles.q: How do I join the partner program?
a: Sign up at /partners/ and you'll get your own personal link to share.

articles.q: How much do I earn?
a: You earn 15% of the value of every website order placed through your link.
The order must be placed within 90 days of the click.

articles.q: How do I track my earnings?
a: We send you a monthly statement by email.

contactBody: Our team is happy to help. Email us at info@oxira.sa and we'll get back to you.
